title: NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM: a Python path from a model definition to faster GPU inference
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM: a Python library for running language models faster on NVIDIA chips
summary: TensorRT-LLM is on today's GitHub trending list for Python. NVIDIA describes it as a Python API for defining large language models and applying inference optimizations on NVIDIA GPUs, including components for Python and C++ runtimes. The repository has about 15,000 stars and was updated on 6 November. It is the highest new AI-specific repo on the Python trending page after two already covered here, NVIDIA's auto-ontology and Google's agent skills.

whyItMatters: If you already serve a model on NVIDIA hardware, this is the library NVIDIA maintains for turning that model into a faster inference runtime, rather than a generic server. It is not a chatbot, and it is not useful on a machine without a supported NVIDIA GPU. Read the current install notes before you assume a checkpoint will load.
